DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_GoldenHorse:
During the golden age of alchemy on the island, 
its ever-glowing golden fur was highly prized as a catalyst for transmuting gold.
Sometimes drops Feybreak materials when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.

DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_GoldenHorse:
Can be ridden.
Changes the player's attack type to <uiCommon id=|COMMON_ELEMENT_NAME_Earth|/> while mounted.
Sometimes drops Feybreak materials when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
